items.summary: NIHがSaros Therapeutics(がん免疫治療用ナノ粒子薬物送達システムの開発企業)に$1.16Mを助成。STINGアゴニストを組み込んだナノ粒子製剤の安全性・併用療法効果を実証し、IND申請を支援する研究。
items.verbatim: DEMONSTRATING SAFETY AND COMBINATION THERAPY POTENTIAL OF A NOVEL NANOPARTICLE DELIVERY SYSTEM - SUMMARY INTERDISCIPLINARY BIOENGINEERING APPROACHES FOR THERAPY AND DRUG DELIVERY ARE ESSENTIAL TO OVERCOMING THE LIMITATIONS OF IMMUNE CHECKPOINT INHIBITORS, WHICH ARE OFTEN INEFFECTIVE AGAINST “COLD” T

items.industry: 医薬・ライフサイエンス
items.summary: Saros Therapeutics社が、免疫活性化を目的とした新規ナノ粒子製剤(STINGアゴニストの全身投与プラットフォーム)のプロセス開発と前臨床試験のためNIHから$2.05Mの助成を受けた。
items.verbatim: PROCESS DEVELOPMENT AND PRECLINICAL ADVANCEMENT OF A NOVEL NANOPARTICLE FORMULATION FOR IMMUNE ACTIVATION - SUMMARY DESPITE THE SUCCESS OF IMMUNE CHECKPOINT INHIBITORS FOR SOME TYPES OF CANCER, THE OVERALL RESPONSE RATE REMAINS SUBOPTIMAL. THE MAJORITY OF SOLID TUMORS EXCLUDE T-CELLS (TERMED “COLD”)
